recommendations.regimenLabel: Staging + MDT-directed definitive therapy; supportive/complication drugs structured below
steps: CT chest/abdomen and tissue diagnosis (bronchoscopy/biopsy); PET-CT for staging.
Treatment by type/stage: surgery (early NSCLC), chemoradiotherapy, targeted/immunotherapy by molecular profile; SCLC is chemo-sensitive.
Smoking cessation; manage complications (effusion, SVCO, hypercalcaemia, cord compression).

drugRefs.regimenLabel: Corticosteroid for SVCO / metastatic cord compression
drugRefs.dose: 16 mg/day (e.g. 8 mg twice daily), with PPI cover
drugRefs.why: Reduces peritumoural/spinal-cord oedema in superior vena cava obstruction and metastatic spinal cord compression while urgent radiotherapy/stenting is arranged.

drugRefs.dose: 4 mg IV over ≥15 min (renal-adjusted), after rehydration
drugRefs.freq: single dose, repeat no sooner than 7 days
drugRefs.why: Treats malignancy-associated hypercalcaemia (given after saline rehydration) by inhibiting osteoclastic bone resorption.

drugRefs.dose: IV volume repletion (e.g. 3–4 L/24 h if tolerated)
drugRefs.why: First step in malignant hypercalcaemia — restores intravascular volume and promotes calciuresis before bisphosphonate.

decision.label: Urgent MDT referral; treat oncological emergencies

confirm: Cough, haemoptysis, weight loss, or an incidental mass in a smoker; CT chest and tissue diagnosis with staging.
